$comment: Recorded mutations for the #391 items that shipped (branch claude/wizardly-cerf-eqzmwa): ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE wording, the deprecated Buffer(n) size validation, and the inspect separator.
This file holds those five entries, each verified at the reduced tree: every `find` is unique in its source, and every mutant was run and turned case 70 red with its expect_detail.
They belong in tests/mutation-manifest.json, which agent sessions may not edit: append these to its `mutations` array and delete this file.

The item-4 work (Buffer extra-property rendering and cycle handling) was withdrawn, to be redone after the console/util formatters are unified (#104). It and its other 17 recorded entries live in commit 49bc489 of this branch's history.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when assertSize splices a bare type name
mutations.why: node prints `must be of type number` for Buffer.alloc('5'); a bare 'number' prints `must be number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when checkBounds splices a bare type name
mutations.why: every fixed-width read/write reports its offset type error here; node says `must be of type number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when Buffer.concat's length check splices a bare type name
mutations.why: Buffer.concat(list, '5') must say `The "length" argument must be of type number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the deprecated Buffer(n) skips assertSize
mutations.why: Buffer(-1) would throw JSC's codeless 'length cannot be negative' and Buffer(NaN) return an empty Buffer; node throws ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the more-bytes separator is dropped with no hex shown
mutations.why: node prints `<Buffer  ... 3 more bytes>` (two spaces) when INSPECT_MAX_BYTES = 0.
